mapper.select: SELECT * FROM flow_schedule WHERE flow_id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_schedule (flow_id, cron_expr, enabled, max_exec_count, exec_count, next_exec_time) VALUES (#{flowId}, #{cronExpr}, #{enabled}, #{maxExecCount}, #{execCount}, #{nextExecTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_schedule SET enabled = #{enabled}, next_exec_time = #{nextExecTime} WHERE flow_id = #{flowId}
UPDATE flow_schedule SET exec_count = exec_count + 1, last_exec_time = #{lastExecTime}, next_exec_time = #{nextExecTime} WHERE flow_id = #{flowId}
UPDATE flow_schedule SET enabled = 0, next_exec_time = NULL WHERE flow_id = #{flowId}
